text: Opening screen: the orange hint 'The NEXT line ... says what comes next' is drawn on top of the help line 'W A S D walk Shift hurry Mouse look E use', both unreadable where they overlap

Codex 'Other schools' page body text and citations are very small at 640x360 (several lines of ~6px serif), hard to read; left-hand page list also truncates 'The space in the pot' to 'The space in the pot' clipped at the panel edge

Waiting on the ghat for the sunset: NEXT gives no hint how long the wait is; 30 game-seconds (17:23 to 17:53) went by with no change. In this stepped headless run 30 s of game time took ~5.5 min wall-clock (~5-6 fps, cpu 125%)

First snake on the dusk path became a rope after ~3 s of steady look with the lamp lit; good payoff. But the NEXT line 'Go closer with the lamp, then look at it steadily (1' runs off the right edge at 640x360, so the snake counter is cut off

Lamp-lit house wall right in front of the camera turns pale yellow and washes out the white HUD text (NEXT/CHORES/MADE nearly unreadable); also the NEXT distance '6 m ahead' points through the wall to the door on the far side with no hint to go around

After E at the indigo door ('E sleep until morning'): 'You sleep, and dream.' The world stays at dusk-light, the clock runs BACKWARD (7:00 pm -> 6:03 -> 5:45 -> 4:45 pm, still 21 March), and NEXT says only 'Nothing here seems strange'. No hint of what to do or how the dream ends; a player expecting morning is stuck

Still in the dream ~45 game-seconds after sleeping: clock now 2:54 pm and falling, no morning, NEXT unchanged 'Nothing here seems strange'. Stopped here for time; could not reach the morning to try V there
